About

CBMS aims to bring together past, present and future African and Caribbean medical personnel, to celebrate the achievements of Cambridge black medics past and present.

CBMS aims to bring together past, present and future African and Caribbean medical personnel, to celebrate the achievements of Cambridge black medics past and encourage the university to aim for racial equality in the medical field.
